lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
contacts-oca: 888 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 871 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 17 B.
contacts-main: 708 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 674 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 34 B.
contacts-files-action: 691 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 674 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 17 B.
All 4 pages load the same 1 file: 253,468 B raw, 94,458 B gzip, 99.6 % of the smallest page (contacts-admin-settings, 254,485 B).
Inside: @vue/runtime-core 63,997 B, axios 46,319 B, vite-plugin-node-polyfills 29,518 B, dompurify 29,331 B, @vue/runtime-dom 26,654 B.
moment, 353,896 B on the contacts-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,518 B on the contacts-oca page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
1,239 B in 1 piece of 1 file have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (101 packages, 769 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
